_readme: Judge eval (R7/D24). 'label' must be set by a human (pass|fail) after reading user+bot against 'expectation'. 'suggested_label' is Claude's proposal, NOT ground truth. Unlabelled items are skipped by the eval.

items.user: I don't know about pricing.
